newsitem.title: FRANCE: DHL sees autumn Rhine valley hub decision.
newsitem.headline: DHL sees autumn Rhine valley hub decision.

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express said it now expects to take a decision on the location of its proposed Rhine Valley hub this autumn.

DHL's corporate affairs spokesman Guy Collette told Reuters in a telephone interview from Brussels that several sites were still under consideration including a military base at Meyenheim, near Colmar.

On July 9 French prime minister Lionel Jospin was quoted as saying:" that despite the job creation prospects linked to the proposal, most of the local authorities concerned (near Colmar) are against the project.'
In a letter to local French deputy, Jean-Pierre Baeumler, Jospin added: "I cannot therefore see any special reason why the state should back the DHL project."

Commenting on the letter, DHL's Collette said: "We have not been notified by the French authorities of their opposition to Meyenheim as a possible site and will push for an early meeting with them to clarify this before making a statement."
Last month, a spokesman for France's Ministry of Defence said a soon-to-be decommissioned military airfield at Toul-Rozieres was "the only site on offer to DHL."
Collette added: "Toul-Rozieres has never been in the running as the location of the hub," but added that DHL was still committed to creating a hub in the region.

"What is uppermost for us in choosing a site is that we have the backing and support of all the relevant authorities concerned. We continue to look at several locations and a decision is likely to be made during the autumn."

In 1996, Strasbourg-Entzheim airport was all set to emerge as DHL's Rhine Valley air cargo hub when the project collapsed amid environmental protests by residents and political leaders. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
